It is not an airdrop factory (no dump seen), graduation was instant, and the 30-minute drawdown is only 8.8%. Post-launch buy pressure of 153 SOL from 195 buyers suggests real interest.

What argues against it: the curve data says bundle_share is 1.0 and top3_share is 1.0, meaning the early buying looks concentrated and possibly coordinated rather than broad. Only 2 buyers appear on the curve, and sell-to-buy in the first two minutes was 0.64, so early holders were already taking profit. Recent volume is largely churn: 661 SOL bought against 624 sold, with net flow of only 37 SOL. A launch bot was present. With a 30-second execution delay and 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs on a $20 ticket, a 9% pullback from the high would erase much of the edge before we fill.

Verdict: no strong case. The momentum is real, but the concentration and churn match patterns that have historically lost money for late entries. Skip.
